questions.stem: Photosynthesis is classified as an endothermic reaction. Which statement best explains why?

options.text: It produces oxygen as a waste product
It occurs only in the presence of chlorophyll
It absorbs light energy from the sun, storing it in glucose molecules
It releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere

questions.explanation: Photosynthesis is endothermic because it absorbs light energy from the sun. This energy is used to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose, which stores more chemical energy than the reactants. The products have more energy than the reactants.
